reviews.text: I love this salon so much! I always get my hair done with Doris she never disappoints. The other girls there are just as amazing. Just recently I went and had my nails done for my birthday by cami and I can only say it was everything that I dreamed off!
Absolutely amazing! My hair came out better than I expected! This is the best my hair has ever came out across any other salon I’ve been to. I rec 100%

The owner/amazing hairstylist, doris, is so kind and welcoming. She has an amazing and lovely personality as well as top notch skill. I recommend her 100/10. My mom and I come to her every time we need a touch up!
